project: Gore Alternate History — Key Divergences from History
scope_note: This file tracks significant deviations from our real-world timeline.

divergences.event: The kidnapping and murder of journalist Daniel Pearl by Al-Qaeda-affiliated militants in Karachi, Pakistan.
divergences.reason_for_divergence: The administration's aggressive and early disruption of Al-Qaeda's financial and logistical networks in Karachi (via 'Operation Financial Lockdown' and subsequent pressure) starved the specific cell of the operational funds and support required to carry out the high-profile abduction.
